name: The Packwright's Trade
intro: Produce is worth a few coppers here and a great deal somewhere it doesn't grow. Bring six sunroot and four barley to my bench and I'll show you how to pack a Harvest Crate. Mind - you'll carry it on your back, and it's heavy.

steps.text: Craft a Lanternwick Harvest Crate at the Specialty Workbench

outro: There. Feel that weight? No sprinting, no second jump, no gliding with it. Now take it somewhere that wants it.
